timer_scope: Preflight outside execution interval. One monotonic nominal30s deadline starts before Popen and covers startup/work/collection/validation/terminal persistence/read/hash/output flush. finalization.py checks after persistence plus read/hash, then after output flush. Successful return0 performs no further I/O or callbacks. No hard OS real-time guarantee; any detected late I/O invalidates acceptance with nonzero exit.
input_validation: Strict built-in types and bounded canonical ASCII decimal grammar/lexical512-bit maximum before int. Positive denominator and gcd1 required. Out-of-interface-size/noncanonical inputs are UNAVAILABLE; never coerced or silently reduced. Internal scratch/time caps are separately declared resource limits.

semantic_boundary.request_receipt_binding: SHA256 of exact canonical primitive payload, role and ordered certificate refs must match; verifier has its own reference hash
semantic_boundary.synthetic_verifier: Exact registry of frozen synthetic fixtures only; receipt scope SYNTHETIC_CONTROL_ONLY. A physically meaningful verifier/certificates remain external OPEN prerequisites.
semantic_boundary.external_verifier_scope: EXTERNAL_VERIFIER_CONDITIONAL does not itself certify physics; module output physical_certification remains false. Caller is responsible for independently audited certificate semantics.
semantic_boundary.family_receipt: Mandatory FROZEN_DOMAIN_FAMILY receipt for exact canonical payload with complete ordered scenario list, test/null IDs and frozen-family/model/algorithm references. Verify before any tail or aggregate. Same family pin with shortened/reordered Domain fails unless a distinct explicit external certificate actually validates that exact frozen domain.
semantic_boundary.family_hash_meaning: No redefinition of family scientific hash. Verifier must bind that existing reference to the complete ordered manifest, independently of each row receipt.
semantic_boundary.synthetic_family_verifier: Registry admits only the two exact synthetic fixture domains a and a,b,c with their existing identities. Neither a,b with the old a,b,c pin nor reordered b,a,c is registered.

resource_trivial_policy: Internal time/scratch ResourceLimit after valid semantic receipt and F9 coherence guard yields explicitly labeled upper1; input/model/identity/support/certificate failure returns null. No implicit retry or alternate scientific method. Completed-branch monotonicity is not promised across resource states.
certificate: Exact positive rational R as bounded hex integers; u/Q with (u-1)^2 B < A Q² <= u² B and1<=u<=Q, checked internally. No float SF/sqrt/exp/log; clock floats only.
aggregation: Require a verified FROZEN_DOMAIN_FAMILY payload before row verification. Every frozen scenario exactly once, with its own verified positive bound record; family list/order/test/null/model/algorithm refs bound to the receipt. Missing/duplicate/extra/invalid/unverified records or a shortened/reordered family reusing the original pin => unavailable. Max over all, then min(1,5p); no alpha or physical verdict calculation.

V2_decision_predicates_unchanged.p_robust_j: Defined only if complete_test_j; maximum over every admitted scenario p upper bound, not a maximum over the available subset.

primary_case_specifications.justification: C04 distinguishes the abstract atom tail0 at positive x from an operationally incoherent positive G/Q/T statistic with certified dimension0. The F9 API must stop INVALID/null, never convert that mathematical reference into a rejection. Nonpositive x still yields1 after semantic validation.
Use lambda0 branch for x<=d; positive rational branch only for x>d; invalid domain/type never converted into trivial1.
x/d=2 and 1+(x-d)/512=257/256; exact rational B for even d provides independent symbolic target of root grid.
No common-float root certificate; exact integer inequalities enclose positive sqrt of R.
512>148, log B derivative negative beyond148 and fixed sqrt/ceil grid monotone. This control presumes completed branches, no resource branch.
Strict positive rational envelope gives fixed positive grid bound even when naive floating exponentials would be unsafe; this is a symbolic expectation, no numerical evaluation performed.

execution_gate.claim: Exclusive CLAIM.json after preflight/authorization and before Popen; existing claim/output blocks launch. Uncertain claim write or process result never retried.
execution_gate.supervisor_child_identity: PIDs, exact argv, request ID, nonce, contract/authorization pins; worker checks parent PID and claim before controls.
execution_gate.terminal: Provisional TERMINAL_RECEIPT plus externally observed exit0 required for acceptance; FINALIZATION_FAILURE invalidates candidate. All failed/uncertain/late outcomes remain nonzero, and missing final process status never accepted.

worker_audit: After preloading stdlib and reading only named package identity/claim/auth/contract/source, an audit hook denies further open/import not preloaded/network/subprocess/mutation; denial is latched. The hook is a Python control, not an OS sandbox proof.

output_capture.caps_scope: Acceptance only, checked after collection (2MiB stdout,64KiB stderr). They do NOT bound retained memory while capture is running.

finalization_protocol.post_output_check: after print(...,flush=True) returns; then return0 only if still before deadline and controls_status PASS, with no further I/O in successful path
finalization_protocol.late_or_IO_failure: Attempt separate FINALIZATION_FAILURE.json, naming provisional hash when known; emit failure best-effort, return1 or4, never0. Any provisional output/receipt is invalidated; it never says terminal PASS.

The final post-output deadline decision is evidenced by external exit0, not by another post-check I/O. Failure record captures observed late timestamp/elapsed when available.
finalization_protocol.unknown_or_nonzero_exit: Never accepted; preserve uncertainty and do not rerun.
